fact: A convention signed on 13 June 2022 between the civil-service ministry MINFOPRA and CAMTEL provides a backup of MINFOPRA's web portal, messaging and SIGIPES at CAMTEL's data centre in Zamengoe; the backup is being set up under the convention, main site place not stated (MINFOPRA's own infrastructure), backup in Zamengoe.
system: CAMTEL data centre at Zamengoe (MINFOPRA backup)
